motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: preserve color/status changes while removing transform movement
motion.purpose: Respect reduced-motion preferences without hiding state feedback.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single forward action for the current task.
components.css: .ds-primary { background: #155EEF; color: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; font: 600 14px/1.35 Schibsted Grotesk, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-primary:hover { opacity: .9; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #155EEF; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Session Row
components.description: Dense week-aware session navigation with explicit status and metrics.
components.css: .ds-session-row { display: grid; gap: 6px; background: #fff; color: #17232B; border: 1px solid #C8D3D9; border-radius: 7px; padding: 10px 12px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-session-row:hover { background: #FBFCFC; border-color: #155EEF; } .ds-session-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #155EEF; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-session-row span { color: #435560; font-size: 12px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Visible text state for planned, completed, adjusted, or missed work.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 28px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #BFD0F0; border-radius: 999px; background: #EAF1FF; color: #1543A5; font: 600 12px/1.35 Schibsted Grotesk, system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: Tempo is an operating surface organized around the Monday-to-Sunday training week. The week is the shared object connecting coach planning, athlete execution, completion, and history. It should feel familiar at first glance, fast under repeated use, and calm when the schedule is dense.
keyCharacteristics: Monday-first hierarchy with a visible current week
One clear next action before secondary metrics
Text-visible planned, completed, adjusted, missed, loading, and error states
Shared session-row, status, metric, and block-structure grammar
Light work surface with restrained depth and strong keyboard focus

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: The active signal owns attention. Status colors explain what happened; they do not compete with the current day or next action.

rules.name: The Measurement Rule
rules.body: Duration, TSS, RPE, dates, and counts use tabular numerals and align as data, not prose.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A surface does not earn a shadow merely because it is a container; elevation communicates a state or overlay.

dos: Do show the week, current day, session status, and next action in one context when the task requires them together.
Do reuse SessionRow, StatusBadge, MetricText, and SessionBlockBar before inventing a route-local session grammar.
Do darken supporting text enough for normal-text contrast and preserve visible keyboard focus.
donts: Don't return to the navy split-board or generic card-grid dashboard as the default composition.
Don't make every bordered region a floating card or every secondary action equally prominent.
Don't use color alone to communicate planned, completed, adjusted, missed, loading, error, or permission states.
